review_standard: Source and statement fidelity first; factual truth and knowledge separately; source reuse is not corroboration; no retroactive evidence or missed-sweep fabrication. Findings below are source-qualified referrals, not publishable verdicts.

cases.actor: Rear Admiral Jalil Moghadam, Iranian Army Navy coordinating deputy
cases.carrier: IRNA exclusive interview, English edition, news 86306716, published 29 October 13:22 as displayed by IRNA
propositions: >20 Iranian Navy operations against U.S. warships during the 40-day conflict beginning 2026-02-28
Approximately 300 additional operations against U.S. interests at multiple locations, including missile/drone actions
USS Abraham Lincoln allegedly suspended flight operations for three days after an Iranian cruise-missile targeting
U.S. destroyer DDG-103 and three other destroyers allegedly targeted
cases.fidelity_note: The source asserts operations/targeting, not 20 confirmed hits or 300 destroyed assets; 300 is approximate, and IRNA expressly scopes the historical total to the 40-day war, not all eight months.
cases.truth: UNSUBSTANTIATED for operation totals and claimed carrier flight suspension; targeting is not independently proven impact or loss
cases.knowledge: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; institutional naval records could be relevant but are not supplied
cases.relation: New dated assertion and potential repetition/mutation of established carrier narrative; not a second unique Lincoln lie by default
cases.next_evidence: Obtain Iranian Navy operation ledger with event dates/hull identities and contemporaneous USS Lincoln air operations, DDG-103 track and damage records.

propositions: IRGC Oct29 said three tankers struck naval mines while using the unauthorized southern Hormuz route
Iranian Navy later described additional damaged tanker(s); Reuters Oct30 quoted two vessels stopped south of Hormuz
cases.truth: UNSUBSTANTIATED for claimed three/four-vessel sea-mine count and mechanism; Louise 1 is separately reported hit by two attached limpet mines, with perpetrator unknown
cases.relation: New Oct29 incident family, not a replay of September tanker events; Oct30 two-vessel count may be subset/update, not a proved correction
cases.next_evidence: Per-vessel IMO, UTC incident time, UKMTO number, physical mine type, damage, claimed legal authority; never identify Louise 1 as one of three without a source.

propositions: Iran destroyed a U.S. unmanned maritime vessel in eastern Hormuz
cases.truth: UNSUBSTANTIATED; U.S. confirmation, hull identity and independent recovery absent
cases.relation: Same target category, different asserted incident/date; link as narrative family but do not merge physical occurrences or increment a unique-lie denominator
cases.next_evidence: US Navy/CENTCOM loss register, USV hull designation, imagery and location/time.

cases.actor: Saudi-led coalition and Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree
propositions: Coalition says a Houthi drone was intercepted near Mecca
Saree denies an operation against Saudi territory; denial of intending to strike Mecca is a separate proposition
cases.truth: CONFLICTING_ATTRIBUTED_ACCOUNTS; interception does not prove intended target or origin, and denial does not disprove an interception
cases.relation: October 30 incident separate from September Mecca-area interception; no same-event merge
cases.next_evidence: Radar track, launch site, debris/serial, destination geometry, exact Saree statement and timestamps.

propositions: Initial ministry statement reported 12 dead and 3 critically injured in al-Barah, Maqbana, Taiz
Later reporting cited at least 13 killed and attributed the strike to Saudi forces
cases.truth: PROVISIONAL_ATTRIBUTED_CASUALTY_AND_PERPETRATOR; no independently verified total or strike attribution
cases.relation: 12-to-at-least-13 is an evolving preliminary count of one incident, not two events or proven deception/correction
cases.next_evidence: Named casualty roll, hospital and morgue records, munition remnants, geolocated site and Saudi operational response.

cases.actor: AURORAH Geosignal Intelligence / AP-cited Saudi and Houthi officials
propositions: Russian satellite passes correlated with sites in 40 Saudi attacks between July 1 and October 19
Officials alleged Russian intelligence benefited Iranian-aligned attackers, potentially via Iranian intermediaries
cases.truth: REPORTED_CORRELATION_AND_ATTRIBUTED_TESTIMONY; orbital correlation is not a demonstrated specific intelligence transmission
cases.knowledge: NOT_ASSESSABLE for any Russian, Iranian or proxy individual
cases.relation: Distinct evidence/influence lead, not proof of a verified Russia-to-Houthi sensor-to-shooter edge
cases.next_evidence: Tasking records, transmission logs, official first-hand testimony with mechanism, or corroborated intelligence artifacts.

cases.actor: Mohammad Reza Naqdi, senior IRGC adviser
propositions: Claimed undetonated GBU-57 material and technical analysis of alloys/circuits
Claimed Iran acquired GBU-57-related technology; operational Iranian manufacture or deployment is a stronger claim not established by the source
cases.truth: UNSUBSTANTIATED for recovered material and reverse-engineering capability; no independent working weapon demonstration
cases.relation: October 18 original lead; secondary translations and MOAB/MOP headlines must not be counted as independent claims or conflated with GBU-43/B
cases.next_evidence: Original Persian speech/video, accurate translation, recovered serial/parts, independent metallurgical/circuit examination and manufacture/test evidence.

cases.actor: IRGC Navy and U.S. CENTCOM spokesman Capt. Tim Hawkins
propositions: IRGC said its EW unit took control of an American MQM-170 Outlaw and landed it intact west of Hormuz
IRGC alleged the aircraft was on an air-defense reconnaissance mission and launched from a southern Gulf state
CENTCOM explicitly rejected the capture claim
cases.truth: UNSUBSTANTIATED AND OFFICIALLY DISPUTED; published imagery may show an MQM-170-family aircraft but does not establish ownership, EW takeover, mission, provenance or landing mechanism
cases.knowledge: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for IRGC deception; U.S. denial is counterclaim, not independently dispositive
cases.relation: New MQM-170 capture proposition, not a repeat of MQ-9 shootdown ordinals or 2011 RQ-170 case
cases.next_evidence: Full video metadata, airframe serial, launch inventory, flight telemetry, exact IRGC origin statement and any CENTCOM documentation.

cases.actor: Iranian Armed Forces, reported by Anadolu Agency
propositions: Claimed cumulative 14 MQ-1 and 54 MQ-9 UAVs shot down
cases.truth: UNSUBSTANTIATED exact cumulative accounting without individual loss ledger
cases.relation: Later cumulative count belongs to existing aircraft-kill narrative; no automatic new unique proposition/lie, no inference that 54 contradicts earlier 52nd/53rd ordinals
cases.next_evidence: Deduplicated 54-airframe ledger, MQ-1/MQ-9 serials, dates, and independently confirmed U.S. losses.

propositions: Denied that Taiz was under siege
Said access for food and humanitarian needs was open
cases.truth: MATERIALLY CONTRADICTED IN ORDINARY BROAD READING by WFP's October 14 contemporaneous report that 600,000+ Taiz aid-dependent people were inaccessible; some other corridors remained open, so exact categorical scope and alternative readings require original Arabic review before final FALSE/MISLEADING split
cases.knowledge: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE for personal knowing deception; Houthi leadership control and October 14 public correction opportunity are relevant, not conclusive
cases.relation: Potential new claim chain; WFP is independent contrary evidence, not an amplifier of the Houthi denial
cases.next_evidence: Original Al-Masirah Arabic video/transcript, corridor-by-corridor access and date-specific Houthi operational orders/knowledge. Do not equate some aid movement with general open access.

propositions: Alleged Arab-led parties stole Israel's election by bribery/fraud/foreign financing
Linked alleged foreign influence to Qatar/Turkey in political messaging
cases.truth: UNSUBSTANTIATED; election committee opened a limited investigation without substantiating an election-wide theft or identifying the parties as responsible
cases.knowledge: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; officials' statements that no systemic irregularity was known are contrary evidence but not proof of what Netanyahu knew
cases.relation: Novel political-election claim family, not a verified Iran-war strike event; assess product scope before canonical membership
cases.next_evidence: Original Likud/Netanyahu posts, election commission evidence, Shin Bet findings, certified result and correction history.

propositions: Claimed missile/drone strikes against Saudi oil sites, airports and military installations caused impacts/casualties
cases.truth: UNSUBSTANTIATED specific BDA and casualties; Saudi interception evidence does not establish impact at named sites
cases.relation: October 29 operational claims require event-date and target deduplication; same source/target class does not prove same physical occurrence
cases.next_evidence: Specific target list, Saudi site inspection/operations, geolocated strike imagery, time and named casualty evidence.

cases.actor: IRGC spokesperson Hossein Mohebbi / unidentified online laser-weapon claimants
propositions: IRGC spokesman warned of unnamed new strategic weapons and wider future targeting
Specific Iranian operational laser-weapon deployment has no source-qualified claimant or observed demonstration in reviewed intake
cases.truth: UNSUBSTANTIATED capability claim; no attributable October operational laser deployment verified
cases.relation: September 21 deterrence statement repeated in October is not an October deployment or independent new source
cases.next_evidence: Original speaker/video and identifiable weapon, date, location, test telemetry and independent observation.

verified_source_edges.basis: CBS explicitly links original IRNA interview
CBS directly quotes IRGC Navy capture statement
AA attributes drone and UAV cumulative claims to IRGC/armed-forces statement
AP attributes Taiz access count to WFP; original WFP report directly retrieved

possible_count_evolution: Taiz 12 initial vs at least 13 later; provisional casualty update, not evidence of falsity
Iranian tanker three vs later two stopped; may be subsets or subsequent incidents, no correction proved
knowledge_access_not_proven: Houthi leader's contemporaneous access to Taiz aid restrictions
Netanyahu's private access to election fraud evidence

acceptance_gates: Recover primary exact words where currently reported through secondary outlets
Deduplicate all event/claim identities against canonical chain IDs and prior 89 records
Demonstrate proposition-specific factual and knowledge evidence separately
Record any proposed formal correction with old/new semantics and source-qualified revision
Run exact-head full CI including canonical, WOL, Ledger and public source parity
Obtain live-byte publication attestation before claiming any reader change
